source.prompt: Soulful house song, about 3.5 minutes, 120 BPM, G minor. Warm, uplifting late-evening glow, joyful and heartfelt. Rich, soulful female lead vocal with gospel-tinged harmonies and call-and-response backing on the chorus. Rhodes electric piano chords, Hammond organ swells, smooth tenor sax answering the vocal, warm finger bass, soft string pad. Four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, offbeat open hats, shaker and tambourine. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal and Rhodes, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
